events.name: Kaş International Film Festival (Kaş Film Fest)
events.when: annually in June; 5th edition scheduled for June 2026, with the award ceremony at the ancient Antiphellos Theatre in Kaş
events.blurb: Annual film festival supported by Türkiye's Ministry of Culture and Tourism and Kaş Municipality, featuring screenings, finalist Q&A sessions and an award ceremony at the 2,000-year-old Antiphellos ancient theatre. Held in Kaş town, roughly 30 km from Patara Beach.

events.name: International Lycia Kaş Culture and Art Festival
events.when: annually in late June (typically around 25-27 June); organised by Kaş Municipality
events.blurb: Three-day cultural and arts festival organised by Kaş Municipality with concerts, performances and cultural events celebrating the Lycian region. Held in Kaş town, the nearest district centre to Patara Beach.

events.name: Kaş Jazz Festival (Kaş Caz Festivali)
events.when: annually in late August (around the last weekend; recent editions on 23-25 August) at Setur Kaş Marina
events.blurb: Annual open-air jazz festival held at the Setur Marina in Kaş, featuring Turkish and international jazz acts. Kaş is the nearest town district to Patara Beach.

events.name: International Meis-to-Kaş Swimming and Canoe Contest
events.when: annual cross-border open-water swim and canoe race from the Greek island of Meis (Kastellorizo) to Kaş harbour, about 7.5 km
events.blurb: Annual open-water swimming and canoeing contest crossing roughly 7.5 km from the Greek island of Kastellorizo (Meis) to Kaş harbour, symbolising Greek-Turkish friendship. Based in Kaş town.

events.name: Antalya Golden Orange Film Festival (Altın Portakal)
events.when: annually in early October; 59th edition 1-8 October 2026
events.blurb: Turkey's oldest and most prestigious film festival, held annually in Antalya with screenings, an awards gala and open-air events in the city centre near Konyaaltı.

events.name: Antalya Akra Jazz Festival
events.when: annually in late May to June; 9th edition 5-20 June 2026
events.blurb: An annual jazz festival bringing world-renowned and local jazz musicians to Antalya for open-air concerts over several weeks in the early summer.

events.name: Antalya Culture Road Festival (Antalya Kültür Yolu Festivali)
events.when: annually as part of Turkey's nationwide Culture Road Festival (2026 series runs April-November); Antalya leg includes free concerts and events on Konyaaltı Beach
events.blurb: Part of Turkey's nationwide Culture Road Festival, the Antalya edition stages free concerts, art and gastronomy events, with Konyaaltı Beach (Konyaaltı Sahili) used as one of the main open-air venues.

events.name: Konyaaltı Beach Park Summer Concerts
events.when: annually throughout the summer season (roughly June-September), open-air concerts along the Konyaaltı seafront and Beach Park
events.blurb: Throughout the summer the Konyaaltı seafront and Beach Park host a regular series of open-air concerts by Turkish pop and other performers, right beside the beach.

events.name: Commemoration of Atatürk (10 November)
events.when: annually on 10 November at 09:05
events.blurb: Nationwide and locally observed commemoration of Mustafa Kemal Atatürk, marked across Antalya with a moment of silence and ceremonies on the anniversary of his death.

events.name: International Lycia-Kaş Culture and Art Festival
events.when: annually towards the end of June (held since 1997); typically around 25-27 June
events.blurb: Long-running festival organised by the Kaş Municipality together with the Greek island of Kastellorizo (Meis), featuring folk dance, music, a swimming race and cross-border friendship events. Held in Kaş town, the nearest locality to Kaputaş Beach.

events.name: Kaş International Film Festival
events.when: annually in June; 5th edition scheduled for June 2026
events.blurb: International film festival supported by Türkiye's Ministry of Culture and Tourism and the Municipality of Kaş, with its award ceremony held at the 2,000-year-old Antiphellos Ancient Theatre. Awarded the EFFE Label 2026-2027 by the European Festivals Association.

events.name: Kaş Jazz Festival (Kaş Caz Festivali)
events.when: annually in late August, at Kaş Setur Marina; 2025 edition ran 28-31 August
events.blurb: Jazz festival held at Kaş Setur Marina featuring prominent Turkish and international jazz musicians, with morning wellness sessions and evening concerts. In its 7th year as of 2025.

events.name: Bodrum International Ballet Festival
events.when: annually in August
events.blurb: An annual ballet festival staged in the ancient amphitheatre and at Bodrum Castle, hosting Turkish and international companies. It has run for over two decades and typically takes place across August.

events.name: International Gümüşlük Classical Music Festival
events.when: annually, summer (roughly July to September)
events.blurb: A summer classical music festival held since 2004 in the fishing village of Gümüşlük on the Bodrum Peninsula, with concerts staged in an open-air ancient stone quarry by the sea. The program spans classical, jazz and other genres over several weeks.

events.name: The Bodrum Cup
events.when: annually in the third week of October
events.blurb: Turkey's iconic wooden gulet sailing regatta, held every October since 1989 and organised by the ERA Bodrum Sailing Club. Around 100 yachts race five legs over five days along the Aegean coast.

events.name: The Bodrum Cup (International Wooden Yacht Race)
events.when: annually, third week of October
events.blurb: Organized by the ERA Bodrum Sailing Club since 1989, this five-day regatta sees over 150 traditional wooden gulets race off the Bodrum coast, accompanied by parties, a cooking competition and a prize-giving ceremony.

events.name: International Gümüşlük Classical Music Festival
events.when: 2026: 7 July – 5 September
events.blurb: A long summer classical music festival held across stages on the Bodrum peninsula (centered on nearby Gümüşlük), featuring around 20 concerts spanning classical, jazz and world music plus masterclasses for young musicians.

events.name: Bodrum International Ballet Festival
events.when: annually in August
events.blurb: Organized by the Turkish State Opera and Ballet since 2002, this summer festival stages classical and contemporary ballet productions at the historic Bodrum Castle and the Theatre of Halicarnassus.

inkumu.town: Bartın (İnkumu / near Amasra), Black Sea coast, Turkey

events.name: Bartın Strawberry, Culture and Tourism Festival (Bartın Çilek, Kültür ve Turizm Festivali)
events.when: annually during strawberry season, late May to mid-June
events.blurb: A long-running annual festival in Bartın celebrating the local strawberry harvest, with concerts, folk dance, exhibitions and strawberry-themed competitions. Running since 1982, it expanded to a week-long event in 1993.

events.name: International Bartın Amasra Culture Festival (Uluslararası Bartın Amasra Kültür Festivali)
events.when: annually (folklore/culture festival on the Amasra seafront)
events.blurb: An international folklore and culture festival held on the seafront promenade in nearby Amasra, featuring folk ensembles, choirs, orchestras, brass bands and dance groups from multiple countries.

events.name: Amasra International City Festival (Amasra Uluslararası Şehir Festivali)
events.when: annually in late summer (late August, ~10 days)
events.blurb: A multi-day international city festival in nearby Amasra covering art, history, science and sport, drawing visitors to the Black Sea coastal town close to İnkumu beach.

events.name: Türkiye Culture Route Festival (Eskişehir)
events.blurb: Eskişehir hosts the nationwide Türkiye Culture Route Festival for the first time in 2026, with 177 free events across 11 venues over nine days, spanning concerts, exhibitions, theatre and gastronomy.

events.name: International Eskişehir Children and Youth Theatre Festival
events.when: annually in May
events.blurb: An annual festival organised by Eskişehir Metropolitan Municipality City Theatres since 2006, bringing children's and youth theatre groups from around the world to the city, recently held together with the International Puppets of the Old City Festival.

events.name: International Eskişehir Dance Festival
events.blurb: The 13th edition of Eskişehir's annual international dance festival, presenting dance companies and performances in the city.

events.name: Eskişehir Coffee Festival (Kahve Festivali)
events.blurb: An annual coffee festival in Eskişehir featuring specialty roasters, tastings and workshops over a long weekend in late May.

events.name: International Alanya Triathlon
events.when: annually in October (2026: October 24-25)
events.blurb: An international triathlon held in Alanya since 1992, featuring a swim, bike and run course along the Mediterranean coast. It is a leg of the Europe Triathlon Cup and one of Turkey's longest-running international sporting events.

events.name: International Alanya Jazz Festival
events.when: annually in late September
events.blurb: An annual jazz festival founded in 2005, staged at the historic Kizilkule (Red Tower) square beneath Alanya Castle. It has grown into an internationally recognized event drawing tens of thousands of visitors.

events.name: Alanya International Culture, Art and Tourism Festival
events.when: annually in late May
events.blurb: Alanya's flagship cultural festival, organized by the municipality since 2001, with free concerts, art exhibitions, traditional crafts and international performances over several days in late May.

events.name: Golden Pigeon Music Festival (Altın Güvercin)
events.when: annually in late summer (late August / September)
events.blurb: A long-running song composition and singing competition organised by Kuşadası Municipality for over 25 years, accompanied by free concerts from well-known Turkish artists. It is Turkey's first and only composition competition and is a major summer event in Kuşadası.

events.name: Kuşadası Summer Fest (International Dance and Music Festival)
events.when: annually in June (2026: June 9-13)
events.blurb: An international folklore festival bringing dance groups, choirs and music bands from around the world to perform in Kuşadası. The 12th edition is scheduled for June 2026.

events.name: Selçuk Camel Wrestling Festival (Deve Güreşi)
events.when: annually on the third Sunday of January
events.blurb: A traditional Turkish camel wrestling championship held near Kuşadası in the nearby town of Selçuk, drawing around 20,000 spectators and roughly 120 decorated Tülü camels. A camel beauty parade is held in the town centre the day before.

events.name: Feast of the Assumption (House of the Virgin Mary)
events.when: annually on 15 August
events.blurb: A Catholic pilgrimage and Mass commemorating the Assumption of the Virgin Mary, celebrated each 15 August at the House of the Virgin Mary near Selçuk/Ephesus, close to Kuşadası.

events.name: Sarıgerme Kite Festival
events.when: annually, first Sunday of May
events.blurb: An annual community kite festival held on Sarıgerme's long sandy public beach, where people of all ages fly hundreds of colourful kites. Running roughly 11am to 5pm, it has been held since 2005 and includes environmental-awareness activities for children.

events.name: Beach Wrestling World Series – Sarıgerme
events.when: held in late May (2022) and mid-October (2023) at Sarıgerme Beach
events.blurb: Sarıgerme Beach is an established stop on the United World Wrestling Beach Wrestling World Series, having hosted the 2018 World Championships and World Series legs in 2022 and 2023 with dozens of male and female wrestlers from many nations competing on the sand.
